general_information.name: UH—SORRY, DO YOU MEAN LIKE THE NAME ON MY HEALTH CARD OR…? I’M NOT SURE WHAT YOU WANT EXACTLY. THERE’S MY FIRST NAME, OLIVIA, AND THEN THE REST IS THERE TOO, I JUST—COULD YOU SAY IT AGAIN MAYBE MORE SIMPLY?
general_information.address: It’s 89 Harbord Street, and then Toronto, Ontario — I’m not great at saying the whole thing in one go, sorry.

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s mostly the finals thing — like the exams are kind of… killing me, which I know sounds dramatic, I don’t mean it literally. For the last couple months I’ve been getting really anxious about them, and the night before I basically can’t sleep, and my stomach gets all upset.
current_concerns.goals: Honestly, just to get through finals without falling apart, and maybe be able to sleep before the exams.
